# Visual & UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Phase 1 - Visual Polish & Atmosphere

**Purpose**: Validate that visual polish, interaction, and accessibility requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation
**Created**: 2026-03-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are visual hierarchy requirements (font sizes, weights, spacing) explicitly specified for all four screens (title, opponent select, game, game over)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are exact color values specified for all faction accent colors (Atreides, Baron, Reverend Mother, Stilgar)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033, plan.md §Faction Config]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are sizing requirements defined for all SVG icon usages (piece icons, card icons, favicon, opponent indicator)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011/FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are font-display swap and system font fallback stack requirements documented for all three new fonts (Cinzel Decorative, Cinzel, Orbitron)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for what the UI looks like during font loading before swap completes (Flash of Unstyled Text behavior)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are all animation duration and easing values specified (ripple 200ms, screen transition 200ms, commentary 300ms, winning line, victory pulse 1.5s, interstitial hold 1-1.5s, first-move fade 300ms)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013/FR-022/FR-020/FR-021/FR-028a/FR-037/FR-041]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for the CC BY 3.0 attribution content, including specific artist names and link target? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are all faction-specific victory title strings enumerated for each opponent (Baron, Reverend Mother, Stilgar) and the player? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are confetti configuration requirements specified (colors, particle count, duration, spread)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are requirements defined for the match score display format and positioning on the game screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK021 - Are `prefers-reduced-motion` requirements consistently defined for ALL animated features (ripple, winning line, screen transitions, commentary slide, victory pulse, confetti, interstitial, first-move fade, sand particles, button feedback, card hover)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are Human vs Human mode exclusions consistently applied across all faction-specific features (FR-032, FR-035, FR-037, FR-039)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the player piece icon consistently identified as the same icon (PlainDagger/crysknife) across spec, plan, and tasks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, plan.md §Icons]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are the three font assignments (Cinzel Decorative for H1, Cinzel for H2-H3, Orbitron for HUD) consistently referenced across all component requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002/FR-003]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the noise texture opacity range consistent between spec ("SVG noise texture overlay" in FR-001) and plan ("4-6% opacity" in Phase A)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001 vs plan.md]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large) consistently stated across all text elements (FR-006, FR-010, FR-025, SC-001)? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK027 - Can SC-001 ("100% of text/background combinations meet WCAG AA") be verified without enumerating every specific combination to check? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK028 - Can SC-005 ("visually distinguishable by icon, border color, and accent without reading text") be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK029 - Can SC-007 ("visible feedback within 200ms") be objectively measured with specified tooling or method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are the acceptance scenarios for each user story specific enough to derive pass/fail test cases without ambiguity? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1-US10]
- [ ] CHK031 - Does SC-008 ("all animations degrade gracefully") define what "gracefully" means concretely (instant cut vs. reduced duration vs. static state)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK032 - Are requirements defined for the game board appearance when all 9 cells are filled (draw state visual treatment)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are requirements defined for how themed icons appear in both HvH and HvCPU modes (which icon represents which player in HvH)? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are requirements defined for screen transition behavior when navigating backward (game → opponent select, opponent select → title)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are requirements defined for the interstitial behavior when the same opponent is selected via Rematch vs. fresh selection? [Coverage, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are requirements defined for how the match score display updates (animation, instant) when a game concludes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are requirements defined for what the turn indicator shows during CPU "thinking" state specifically? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032, data-model.md §Document Title]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK038 - Are requirements defined for z-index stacking order when winning line, game-over overlay, and confetti all render simultaneously? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are requirements defined for what happens if the winning line animation is interrupted by a rapid Rematch click? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are requirements defined for custom cursor behavior on touch devices (where cursor is not applicable)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the edge case for rapid Rematch clicks (spec Edge Cases §4) specific enough about debounce behavior or UI disabling? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK042 - Are requirements defined for how the cinematic interstitial behaves if the user clicks or taps during the hold period? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK043 - Are requirements defined for concurrent animation behavior (e.g., piece placement ripple while winning line draws)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK044 - Is the "60fps using transform/opacity only" performance requirement in the plan also stated as a measurable success criterion in the spec? [NFR, Gap vs plan.md §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK045 - Are bundle size impact requirements or constraints specified for the new dependencies (~88 kB total)? [NFR, Gap]
- [ ] CHK046 - Are requirements specified for which browsers/versions must support the CSS features used (gradients, mix-blend-mode, backdrop, cursor url())? [NFR, Gap]
- [ ] CHK047 - Are focus-visible state requirements defined for all interactive elements (buttons, cells) to support keyboard navigation? [NFR Accessibility, Gap]
- [ ] CHK048 - Are screen reader announcement requirements defined for game state changes (piece placement, turn change, game over)? [NFR Accessibility, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK049 - Is the assumption that desktop viewport (1024px+) is the only target explicitly documented as an out-of-scope boundary in the spec? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK050 - Is the Orbitron font's optional nature (FR-003 "optionally") clearly bounded with a specific fallback decision criteria? [Assumption, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK051 - Is the dependency on game-icons.net SVG assets documented with specific icon names, URLs, and license compliance requirements? [Dependency, Spec §FR-014, research.md §R1]
- [ ] CHK052 - Is the assumption that match score resets on page refresh (no localStorage persistence) explicitly stated as a deliberate design choice vs. limitation? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
